def fn(t0, t1, t2, k, lst, dct):
    v1 = t2.unfold(1, 1, 3)
    v2 = v1.flatten()
    v3 = v1[1:4:2, :, :]
    t0.masked_fill_(t1 > 0, k)
    t1[3] = k
    v4 = torch.cat([t1, t2], 1)
    v5 = v4 * 0
    v2[5] = 0
    idx6 = torch.tensor([3], device=v4.device)
    v4.index_add_(0, idx6, v5.narrow(0, 0, 1))
    return (v3, v1, t0, v3, t1, lst, dct)
